page.layout: One page of text, no columns, no margin notes. The text is so faint and blurred that no words can be read.
page.notes: The scan is a very faint, out-of-focus photograph of a typed or printed page. Lines of text are visible as grey bands, but no letters or words can be made out, so no transcription is possible. Small specks and stains are scattered across the page and are not printed text. The faint marks at the top and bottom edges show no readable running head, page number or catchword. Nothing is transcribed, to avoid inventing words.
